company.name: Mistle
company.shortDescription: Mistle provides an open-source platform and cloud service for orchestrating sandboxed autonomous coding agents in engineering workflows.
company.description: Mistle provides an open-source platform for running, orchestrating, and automating sandboxed coding agents within software engineering workflows. The platform enables engineering teams to deploy collaborative background AI agents that can inspect, modify, and verify code inside secure, isolated environments. Mistle integrates with tools and services such as GitHub, Slack, Jira, Linear, Datadog, and major large language models to give agents the context they need. It offers identity mapping so actions taken through provider APIs can be attributed back to specific human developers. The system supports use cases like asynchronous debugging, automated code reviews, and direct repository changes while maintaining control through customizable sandbox profiles and environment snapshots. Mistle Cloud adds a managed, hosted option for teams that want to run these capabilities without operating their own infrastructure.
